title_zh: 约定获取诊所收费资料后自行核实保险

scenario.label_zh: 询问诊所保险与费用核对渠道
scenario.goal_zh: 约定由诊所发送收费单及账单名称、咨询代码和联系方式，决定向保险方核实覆盖范围后再预约

context_zh: 来电者向诊所接待员询问一项非紧急咨询的收费信息。
author: author-phase08-a

sentences.speaker: Leah
sentences.text: I'm comparing local healthcare services. Can you tell me the price of a first consultation?

sentences.speaker: Martin
sentences.text: It's listed on our fee sheet. I can email that to you.

sentences.speaker: Martin
sentences.text: I can't confirm your cover. You'll need to ask your insurer about the service and this clinic.

sentences.speaker: Leah
sentences.text: Could you include the clinic's billing name and the consultation code?

sentences.speaker: Martin
sentences.text: Of course. They'll be on the sheet, along with our contact details.

sentences.speaker: Leah
sentences.text: Thank you. I'll check with the insurer before I make an appointment.

targets.sense_zh: 承担约定医疗费用风险的保险
